spans.text: ...A group of Dolls runs through a snowy, wind-whipped battlefield, firing behind them as they move.
Amidst this heavy bombardment, the Paradeus mech pursuing them finally collapses to the ground.
This is great... The Doppelsöldner's down!
Look out!
There is a loud explosion, causing General Liu to lose her balance and fall heavily into the snow as intense pain courses through her back.
AUG Para is behind her, but how could she make a mistake like that...?
Still dazed, General Liu looks behind her and sees AUG Para also lying face-down in the snow.
Grenades have shredded her body and it looks like there's no chance of her ever getting back up.
She did it to cover me... And it was done because...
VHS, a Doppelsöldner's coming!
I know, the HOCs are ready!
M200 and I will take it out, you give us long-range fire support!
Got it!
Support fire thunders down from the distance, blowing the relentless White Faction mech to pieces.
However, the Dolls remain frozen in place, unable to move.
I can't move, VHS... I've been...hacked... It's...her...
M200 drops her gun and collapses like a puppet whose strings have been cut.
VHS and General Liu remain rooted to the spot, facing forward. A slender figure steps out of the gunsmoke and flames, smiling arrogantly at them.
Oh, you servile Dolls, inn of grief, ship without helmsman in a mighty tempest...
Mercurows...
VHS is having trouble working her arm, but she reaches out toward a nearby command console.
The defense gate closes in from either side, crushing that figure between its slabs with a deep and heavy thunk.
The electronic interference is weakening! Thank goodness! Now...
Huh? Why is...the defense gate...being pushed open...
A laughable performance, ladies. No man steps into the same trap twice, and this gate isn't exactly hard to hack.
"Behold. Whether that race has done good or evil during its lifetime will make no difference in the end."
Mercurows spreads her arms and raises them in an exaggerated manner.
An indescribable noise assaults the Dolls. Their neural clouds are unable to bear the strain, and in the end they all go offline.
Signals lost from four Dolls. One Doll is unable to move.
Combat Simulation No. 5 - Failed. Difficulty - Normal. Time elapsed - 5 minutes. Distance travelled - 1000m. System grading - C.
Restarting Combat Simulation. All four Doll positions have been reset.
Beginning Combat Simulation No. 6.
Huh? It's over? But I didn't even move...
...Please pause this. We need to do a review.
Exiting simulation mode.
The Squad Puzzle Dolls disconnect from the simulator and rise from their seats.
In this last battle, we encountered the elite enemy unit Mercurows.
She is an extremely skilled hacker. On top of that, she can restrain a single target and limit our ability to deal damage.
Maybe we could use a drone as bait or have someone volunteer to take the attack while the others open fire while she is restrained?
But if we do that, that teammate will... Ah, sorry, I'll defer to your opinions.
I look away at this point, turning to address Dandelion, who has been connected to the control terminal all this time.
Still no progress?
No. Well, objectively speaking, they HAVE made an improvement.
They didn't even last long enough to leave a record during the first combat sim, but now they have five minutes' worth of data.
I brought Gr SL8 in to make up for the loss in combat power, so why is it still like this?
The deployment for the combat simulations has VHS as team leader, AUG Para as vanguard, General Liu as support while M200 provides long-range precision fire.
While the temporary transfer Gr SL8 has excellent stats, VHS has no intention of making use of her. All she does is use Gr SL8 as a hostage.
Meanwhile, Squad Puzzle has finished their review of the battle on the training ground.
Gr SL8 looks like she wants to say something, but VHS ignores her.
The other three Dolls shoot her apologetic looks as they head off after VHS.
Looks like they're not meshing well.
That does seem to be the case. Frankly speaking, Commander, I do not understand the intention of this training program.
If your objective is to accustom the majority of our Dolls to battling Paradeus forces, then we have already achieved our objective.
Squad Puzzle clearly does not make the grade, so why not remove them from deployment during operations?
I know what you mean. Not every Doll can gain the skills needed to fight Paradeus units through training.
The wise choice would be to not waste time and resources on them and spend them on Dolls with more promise instead.
Indeed.
According to the intel we received from Ange in Bremen, Paradeus is far more active than we imagined.
Since we'll be facing off against them sooner or later, I would like all the Dolls at the base to be prepared for that eventuality.
I won't allow mass casualties like last time to happen again.
That does sound like something you would say, Commander.
More to the point, this is also Kalina's plan.
I promised her that I would take good care of the base in her place.
I fall silent as I think of Kalina.
Paradeus, Kalina's illness, and the chaotic situation weigh heavily on my heart.
As I watch how swiftly the Mission Failed pop-up appears for the Dolls of Squad Puzzle, I silently add the battle readiness level of Griffin to the list of my worries.
Combat Simulation - Failed.
Do you really wish to continue?
Yes. However, things can't go on like this. I need to think of a way to speed up the process.
What do you mean?
Let me speak to them.
Squad Puzzle, can you hear me?
Loud and clear.
I'll be directing the battle this time.
...Understood.
Squad Puzzle standing by! Ready for orders, Commander!
